sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Add a refreshing pop of color to your jewelry collection with these stunning gold-plated mint green floral stud earrings. Designed with soft mint stones arranged around a sparkling crystal center, these earrings bring a perfect blend of elegance and subtle glamour. The gold detailing enhances the premium look, making them ideal for both casual and festive styling.
- Lightweight and comfortable for everyday wear, these studs pair beautifully with Western, Indo-western, and ethnic outfits. Their fresh, modern appeal makes them a versatile accessory for brunch outings, office wear, celebrations, and gifting.
- Keywords included: mint green earrings, floral stud earrings, gold-plated studs, crystal center earrings, pastel jewelry for women, lightweight daily wear studs, party wear earrings.
